_note: Tuning for check.py. Start conservative and tune against real diffs. Thresholds are tuned against `model`; re-tune when it changes. Never carry a threshold across primitives: a Noul value and a Choice confidence are not comparable. Changing this file mid-task stops the task until the user runs check.py --accept-config.

goal_clarity._note: Checked at --init, --amend and --accept-goal. Scores are out of 3.0.

scope._note: Checked per file on every step. outside_scope at or above block_verdict_confidence blocks; any drift Noul at or above drift_block blocks; a verdict below min_verdict_confidence escalates to the user.

completion._note: Every goal item must score at or above item_complete for GOAL COMPLETE.

request_budget._note: Jev allows 32k tokens for state plus the longest question per request. Code tokenizes denser than prose, so estimate low and keep headroom.

handoff._note: Context usage at which the agent hands off to a new session, used only when reliable usage information is available.
